title: Aaron Rodgers on DK Metcalf's bad game: I'm not worried, I love DK

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Aaron Rodgers on DK Metcalf's bad game: I'm not worried, I love DK
sources.description: Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf had a rough game in Week 1, dropping passes, twice getting called for offensive pass interference, and gaining just 40 receiving yards on the 10 passes Aaron Rodgers threw to him.
